title: Order details with customer and product
statement_markdown: Write a query to find information based on customers, products, orders, order_items.
hints: Review the problem statement and expected output.
reference_solution: SELECT c.name AS customer_name, p.name AS product_name, oi.quantity FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id ORDER BY c.name
